caption: The drawing is rendered in pencil on aged, off-white paper and depicts a metallic spout cup with a curvaceous body, a domed lid with a finial, a spout extending from the upper middle of the body, and a large, ornate handle attached to the side. The main illustration shows a three-quarter perspective of the cup, revealing both the front and side, with careful shading used to indicate the reflective, rounded surface of the metal. Below and to the left of the main image, there is a smaller, simplified side view of the same cup, outlined without shading and labeled "SIDE VIEW." On the right side, handwritten text reads: "SPOUT CUP NO. 35.31L CASE #4 6 INCHES HIGH." The name "Eugene Bonnell" appears at the bottom right. The drawing is framed within a double rectangular border, with visible wear, stains, and discoloration especially around the edges.
title: Silver Spout Cup
